headline: TALK ME DOWN's rulebook stops lying — D4 keeps its answer
lede: The couch-killing bug in the split-info bomb is dead: cutting the wire module no longer flips the dial's answer under the paper manual. And the nightly triage names exactly what still keeps the smoke suite red — with two of its eight failures already fixed and proven.

notes.text: TALK ME DOWN #1708 (PR #1721): D4's 'another module has wires' rule anchors to the layout — 86% of round-3 bombs used to change the dial's answer after the sibling cut; the printed page is now true for the whole bomb. bombcheck 35->38 gates, guard-mutant dies exactly there.

Main triage (nightly #40): of 11 smoke reds, SSX + iron-ring are CI render-stall flakes (green locally); blob-battle and civ-v are fixed in draft PR #1720 (gate graded rounds the CPU must lose; the prover's early win restarted the chain). zork, simcity-min, paperboy, ice-climber remain — full repro in #1637.

simcity-min's WATCH seat is provably dead code: seatWatch replays the planner's script against an idle city, but the planner acts from tick 0, so the hash can never match. Filed on #1637 with the Node proof.
Source-pin lesson repeated: regex windows must be measured (D4 id->find is 640 bytes; a 600 window pinned a comment instead of code).
